I've been clicking around the real thing, and it feels like the app we designed together. It opens to my own empty collection with the same clean layout — All bookmarks, Read later, and Archive down the side, the search box up top, and the friendly "Save your first find" prompt. I saved a couple of links and they turned into readable items I could open, edit, label, search, tuck into read-later, and archive, and my saves stuck around, which is what I wanted for something that's just mine.

Taken together with everything I confirmed in the previews and your report that all the behaviors and tests passed, this delivers the twenty things we agreed on. I'm satisfied — I accept it.

I'll note for down the road that I may think of more I'd like (things like jotting my own notes on a bookmark, or bringing in the bookmarks I already have elsewhere), but those are for another day and don't hold up today's acceptance.

Thank you — this is exactly the tidy, findable collection I was hoping to end up with.
